fields.label: Hero Badge Override
fields.name: hero_badge
fields.instructions: Custom ribbon text at the very top of the hero section. Default is: #No.1 ERP Solution in [City Name]

fields.label: Hero Description Override
fields.name: hero_description
fields.instructions: Lead text description under the main heading. Will fallback to a generated description if blank.

fields.label: Manufacturing Section Lead Text
fields.name: mfg_lead_text
fields.instructions: Lead text under the Manufacturing section title. e.g. From footwear factories to marble workshops and iron foundries.

fields.label: Manufacturing Specialty Title
fields.name: mfg_specialty_title
fields.instructions: Heading of the first manufacturing specialty card. Default: Industrial Specialty (e.g. Footwear Specialty, Textile Specialty).

fields.label: Manufacturing Specialty List Items
fields.name: mfg_specialty_list
fields.instructions: Enter lists of manufacturing specialty items, one per line. If blank, standard fallback list will show.

fields.label: Retail Section Lead Text
fields.name: retail_lead_text
fields.instructions: Lead text under the Retail section title. e.g. Dominating local markets from main roads to hubs.

fields.label: Retail Specialty List Items
fields.name: retail_specialty_list
fields.instructions: Enter list items for retail/POS features, one per line. If blank, standard fallback list will show.

fields.label: Custom FAQs List
fields.name: faqs_repeater
fields.instructions: Add custom questions and answers for this city. Leaving this empty uses default dynamic FAQs.
